---
title: "BIRTHS: Birth Registrations"
description: "Information on persons born in Australia and their parents, including demographics and location information."
---

Information on persons born in Australia and their parents, including demographics and location information.

*Defines registered-birth scope, source registries, collection method, geography and quality limitations.*
